upgrade-folder.unix:
cd "$HOME/Downloads/openldr_ce"
docker compose images
docker compose ps -a
upgrade-folder.windows:
Set-Location C:\openldr_ce
docker compose images
docker compose ps -a

upgrade-stop.unix:
docker compose stop -t 300 api
docker compose ps -a api
docker compose logs --tail 100 api

upgrade-dump.unix: docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dump -Fc -f /tmp/DB_NAME.dump -U DB_USER DB_NAME

upgrade-roles.unix:
docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dumpall --globals-only -f /tmp/globals.sql -U DB_USER
docker compose cp postgres:/tmp/globals.sql "$HOME/openldr-backups/BEFORE_UPGRADE/globals.sql"
upgrade-roles.windows:
docker compose exec -T postgres pg_dumpall --globals-only -f /tmp/globals.sql -U DB_USER
docker compose cp postgres:/tmp/globals.sql "$HOME\openldr-backups\BEFORE_UPGRADE\globals.sql"

upgrade-minio-config.unix:
services:
  minio:
    image: EXACT_PREVIOUS_MINIO_IMAGE
    pull_policy: never
    command: server /data
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: OLD_KEY
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: OLD_SECRET
    volumes:
      - miniodata:/data
volumes:
  miniodata:
upgrade-minio-config.file: docker-compose.yml, merge with the new services

upgrade-pull.unix: docker compose pull api studio web gateway

upgrade-migrate.unix: docker compose run --rm --no-deps api node /app/cli/dist/index.js db migrate

upgrade-storage-copy.unix:
docker compose run --rm --no-deps api node /app/cli/dist/index.js storage copy \
  --from-endpoint http://minio:9000 --from-key OLD_KEY \
  --from-secret OLD_SECRET --from-bucket SOURCE_BUCKET
upgrade-storage-copy.windows:
docker compose run --rm --no-deps api node /app/cli/dist/index.js storage copy `
  --from-endpoint http://minio:9000 --from-key OLD_KEY `
  --from-secret OLD_SECRET --from-bucket SOURCE_BUCKET

upgrade-start.unix:
docker compose up -d storage keycloak
docker compose up -d api studio web gateway
docker compose ps
